drafts.text: You should buy more units while prices are low.
HDFC small cap funds usually recover quickly, so keep going.
Hurry, don't miss out on cheap prices this month.
The market will recover soon and your SIP will double.
I recommend continuing your SIP for at least five years.
Returns are guaranteed if you stay invested long enough.
Putting your money in a balanced option is the smarter move for you right now.
If you stop now you will regret it later.
It is normal for values to move up and down. A SIP invests a fixed amount each month, so it buys more units when prices are lower and fewer when higher. Returns are not guaranteed.
That is a fair reason. You can pause or lower the amount whenever it suits you. For personal guidance, speak to a SEBI-registered investment adviser.
Units can take a few working days to show after money leaves your bank. Check the order status in the app, or contact support if it stays unclear.
We cannot advise on which fund to choose. Official information is at investor.sebi.gov.in and amfiindia.com.
